home.name: How to record part of a web page as video with sicorder
home.description: Record a single element of a web page to an MP4 using the sicorder Chrome extension.

steps.name: Install sicorder
steps.text: Add the sicorder extension to Chrome from the Chrome Web Store.

steps.name: Pick a region
steps.text: Click the sicorder toolbar icon, turn on Pick Region, and click the element to record.

steps.name: Record
steps.text: Press Record and interact with the page.

steps.name: Stop and save
steps.text: Press Stop. The MP4 is saved to your Downloads folder.
